title: Illusion Magic
description: If you aren't a Wizard, you can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from the **Illusion** (substance: sight and/or sounds; verbs: cloak; disguise) School of Magic. At the start of each session you get Aether equal to your int. For more details, see the Wizard Starting Move, **Weave the Arcane**.

outcomes.text: If you're a Wizard, add the following verbs to your repertoire:

submoves.description: Once per Scene, when someone believes in one of your illusions, clear a Condition.

title: Alter Perception
description: When you **touch someone or something**, you can alter their perceptible aspects without **Casting a Spell**; mark a **Condition** if they are unwilling. For example you can change someone's perceived ancestry, outfit or accent, or you can make an item seem magical, brand new, or made of a different substance. The effect lasts until you dismiss it or until the end of the Scene.

title: Mirror Image
description: When you **would suffer damage**, you may spend 1 Aether to reveal that you were an illusion and prevent all dmg; say where **near** you actually are.

title: Fool Me Once...
description: When you **trick someone with an illusion**, the next time you **Pull Strings** on them you have **adv** and may roll+INT (instead of +CHA), even if they learn it was an illusion. You can share these benefits with other PCs that were part of the illusion.

title: The Mirror Stares Back
description: The first time each NPC **falls for one of your illusions**, you may ask them one question as if you **Sensed Motive**.

outcomes.text: When you **Cast a Spell** **to make an illusory copy of a person**, you can also mark a **Condition** to overcharge the spell.  If you do, the illusory person perfectly imitates their original, lasts indefinetly, and starts loyal but slowly gains autonomy over time. You cannot dismiss an overcharged illusory person.
